cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You can borrow the dress for ten pounds and an acknowledgment that you mocked it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Money covers fabric. It doesn't cover wearing my bad taste proudly.

seedUse: Keep extra-money offer and beauty concession; make second emotional cost an actual social action.
